title: Analysis of carotenoid compounds in aphids by Raman imaging and mass spectrometry
protocol: Determine the concentration of the β-carotene standard solution by measuring its absorbance at 451 nm in a hexane solution using the extinction coefficient of β-carotene (ε1%) in hexane (= 2592).
Prepare successive dilutions of the initial β-carotene solution in hexane.
Store the initial β-carotene solution in an amber vial under nitrogen atmosphere at -80°C for a maximum of one week.
Weigh one gram of aphids before milling using liquid nitrogen.
Hand-mill the aphids using liquid nitrogen to obtain powder.
Perform all extractions and standard solution preparations under red-light conditions.
Inject carotenoid extracts immediately into HPLC column after preparation.
Do not filter carotenoid extracts dissolved in dichloromethane / MTBE/methanol mixture before HPLC analysis.
Prepare 15 mL of solvent A: ethanol (20 mL)/hexane (15 mL) containing 35 mg of BHT as antioxidant.
Prepare 80 mL of 10% sodium chloride.
Weigh 1 g of aphids (balance precision ± 0.01 mg).
Carefully mill the aphids in a mortar pestle with liquid nitrogen.
Add 15 mL of solvent A and 80 mg of MgCO3 to a 50 mL beaker and stir for 5 min.
Filter the mixture on a filter funnel number 2.
Wash the precipitate successively with 15 mL of solvent A, 15 mL of ethanol, then with 15 mL of hexane.
Transfer the solvent mixture in a separatory funnel.
Wash once with 40 mL of 10% sodium chloride.
Wash twice with 40 mL of distilled water.
Recover the hexanic phase in a beaker.
Dry the phase with 1 g of sodium sulfate and filter on a cotton glass in a 100 mL conical flask.
Evaporate the dried organic phase using a rotavapor at a temperature not exceeding 40°C.
Resuspend the residue with 250 μL of dichloromethane and 250 μL of MTBE/methanol (80:20, v/v).
Inject the extract quickly on HPLC for analysis.
Maintain pea aphids on Vicia faba plants.
Raise aphids in cages at about 22°C ± 3°C with a photoperiodicity of 16/8 hours light/dark.
Raise aphids at 8°C ± 1°C with a humidity of 60% to select the green phenotype.
Place 10 orange adult aphids each day at 8°C ± 1°C for five months to isolate the green variant.
Transfer green variants back to room temperature conditions, where they revert to the orange phenotype within two days.
